Yes. Each piece carries its own label, and the piece number is part من the barcode, so every label in a shipment is different. You can print a range, for example pieces 11 to 20, if you are labelling in batches.

The last digit من an 8-digit air waybill serial is normally the first seven digits divided by 7, taking the remainder. If it does not match, the number may have been mistyped. Check it against your air waybill.
